# Ocechain

> Ocechain is maritime intelligence on Bitcoin: live AIS vessel positions permanently recorded as publicly verifiable ledger entries for insurance, logistics, compliance, and operators.

Ocechain turns ephemeral ship movements into an immutable evidence layer. It is not a navigational aid.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://watching.boats/): Product overview — how AIS positions become permanent Bitcoin records
- [Live fleet map](https://watching.boats/live): Search ships (name, MMSI, call sign) and locations (ports, places, coordinates); open vessel panels and explorer links
- [FAQ](https://watching.boats/faq): Canonical answers on insurance use, on-chain records, data sources, and disclaimers
- [Full description](https://watching.boats/llms-full.txt): Longer product, audience, and technical summary for models that need more context

## What Ocechain is

Ocechain ingests real-time global AIS vessel data and records compact position payloads on Bitcoin. The result is live ship tracking backed by immutable ship records — an evidence layer for marine insurance, logistics, compliance, operators, counsel, researchers, and journalists. For boat watching and vessel spotting enthusiasts, the same live map offers a permanent, verifiable view of fleet movements.

## What Ocechain is not

Ocechain is not a navigational aid and must not be used for collision avoidance or voyage planning.

## Differentiators

- Permanent Bitcoin records of vessel positions
- Public verification via blockchain explorers
- Live map with ship and location search
- Shareable deep links to vessels and regions (`/live?mmsi=`, `/live?q=`, `/live?lat=&lon=&z=`)

## Protocol note

User-facing brand: Ocechain. On-chain OP_RETURN prefix: `Ocechain`. Marketing language refers to Bitcoin (not BSV).
